messages.content: I think I'm scared of being happy because I'm waiting for something to go wrong.
Honestly, that's a really specific and common fear - it has a name, actually, 'fear of happiness' or sometimes called foreboding joy.
Does it ever go away or do I just live with it forever?
It can genuinely ease, honestly, usually through practicing staying present in good moments instead of bracing - not ignoring risk, just not living permanently in anticipation of loss.
